title: Simultaneous electrochemical detection of Cd2+ and Pb2+ using a green silver nanoparticles/polyaniline-modified carbon paste electrode
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29654-29665
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03135D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Djihane Slimane Ben Ali, Ferial Krid, Ahlem Sarra Saadi, Mouna Nacef, Habiba Tabet, Mohamed Lyamine Chelaghmia
A novel electrochemical sensor based on a CPE modified with PANI and green-synthesized AgNPs was developed for the simultaneous detection of Cd2+ and Pb2+ ions in aqueous solution.
